task_summary: Backtested London Daybreak standalone on EURUSD+GBPUSD with M1 execution data across the faithful contrarian-majority rule + 5 target variants (A max50/R, B 1R, C 1.5R, D 2R, E ATR-min); REJECTED — EURUSD net-negative on all variants, GBPUSD shows a thin gross edge (PF~1.06–1.12) that dies at realistic ~2–2.5p cost and is front-loaded into 2004–2010 with net-negative 2020–2024.
